description:
Ask the Delopt team for a plan with more vehicles than the largest
self-serve plan allows (8).

For up to 8 vehicles, upgrading the plan is enough, so nothing is sent: the
answer says which plan fits. Asking again updates the open request. The
team follows up with the account's email address.

note.description: Optional: what the fleet is, or anything else the team should know
